items.item: H10 'emerges' with what is shown, offered and open
items.how: 08 §2 keeps 'The ethics emerges from continuation.' and adds '"Emerges" names neither a derivation nor a shown development: what is shown is conditional ... what is offered is counting the losses of those whose loss never returns to one ... what is open is how such orders form'. I added 'to one' (and 'to oneself' in MAP): without it 'whose loss never returns' reads as irreversible loss, not loss that does not come back to the one concerned. MAP line 9 says the same three parts.

MAP line 9 said 'where relations close, read across all steps, an order holding one's own continuation ranks every widening above, on a finite listing' without the reach reading. Without it the sentence says more than the Lean: `Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn` needs `own` to mark the center's closure, and with a narrow own continuation self-concern ranks only widenings adding to it. Now '... read across all steps, and significance is read as what lies within each center's reach, an order holding ...'.
